mapper.sql: id, user_id, report_date, total_count, submitted_count, graded_count, correct_count, avg_duration_sec, overall_mastery, kp_mastery, weak_points, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_report (user_id, report_date, total_count, submitted_count, graded_count, correct_count, avg_duration_sec, overall_mastery, kp_mastery, weak_points) VALUES (#{userId}, #{reportDate}, #{totalCount}, #{submittedCount}, #{gradedCount}, #{correctCount}, #{avgDurationSec}, #{overallMastery}, #{kpMastery}, #{weakPoints}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_count = incoming.total_count, submitted_count = incoming.submitted_count, graded_count = incoming.graded_count, correct_count = incoming.correct_count, avg_duration_sec = incoming.avg_duration_sec, overall_mastery = incoming.overall_mastery, kp_mastery = incoming.kp_mastery, weak_points = incoming.weak_points
mapper.select: SELECT FROM daily_report WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND report_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY report_date
